items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: I believe his relation to him. He might have been around the house or something like that. Fess told us about him.

ctx.x: When you played with that band, were they playing the same type of music that you'd been playing in New Orleans? I mean the same type of music? Oh yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah. Was it a reading band? Yeah, it was all readings.

In other words, it was a family band. Oh I see. Was that the band that Fess told us about? I believe Joe Dairnsberg, some of his folks. Martell. Was the Martell from the Appalooza? Was Joe Dairnsberg any relation or something? You remember the boy that plays Clarence in the Dory? Yeah, I believe his relation to him. He might have been around the house or something like that. Fess told us about him. He might have married one of the daughters or something. Yeah, I believe he married the daughter of that family.…
Who was in the band? What were the Martell's names?
